type Payload = {kind: 'number'; value: number} | {kind: 'text'; value: string};

function locals(payload: Payload) {
  const {kind, value} = payload;
  if (kind === 'number') return value.toUpperCase();
  return value.toFixed();
}

function parameters({kind, value}: Payload) {
  if (kind === 'text') return value.toFixed();
  return value.toUpperCase();
}

function renamed(payload: Payload) {
  const {kind: tag, value: item} = payload;
  if (tag === 'number') return item.toUpperCase();
  return item.toFixed();
}
